sources.label: Romanian National Naval Museum · original spar-torpedo head and Măcin action
Romanian Navy · history, Rândunica and the 1877 campaign

note: The Romanian Naval Museum preserves a spar-torpedo head of the type associated with Rândunica at Măcin in May 1877. The anonymous steam-launch model therefore carries a contact charge on a spar, not a later self-propelled torpedo or a battleship turret. The Ottoman target and the complete Russo-Romanian flotilla are not reconstructed; animation does not simulate a historical detonation.
